sourceCopy.name: Memory Test
sourceCopy.title: Memory Test Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Try a free memory test with digit-span and visual sequence rounds. Difficulty grows after correct answers; no account or IQ claims.
sourceCopy.intro: Practice remembering a growing sequence of digits or positions on a 3×3 grid. Each correct round adds one item.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does this memory test work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose digits or a visual grid and a display speed. Watch or listen to the sequence once, then enter it in the same order. Correct rounds get longer, up to 12 items. This is a casual practice game, not a standardized memory assessment.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this memory test save my score?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The sequence and score stay in this page while it is open. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account or online ranking.
howTo: Choose digit span or visual pattern and set a comfortable display speed.
Start a round and watch the sequence. In digit mode, each digit is also announced to assist screen-reader users.
Enter every item in order and submit. Correct answers increase the sequence length by one; one wrong answer ends the run.

fields.accessibilityNote: For screen readers, choose Digit span: each digit is announced once during playback. The visual pattern mode depends on sight.
fields.scopeNote: Practice only. This is not an IQ test, diagnosis or validated cognitive assessment. Results have no clinical or population meaning.
fields.readyTip: Choose a mode and speed, then start.

messages.recall: Now enter the sequence in the same order.
messages.correct: Correct. You completed {rounds} rounds. Continue when ready.
messages.incorrect: Not quite. The correct sequence was {sequence}. You completed {rounds} rounds.
messages.finished: Maximum sequence length reached. You completed {rounds} rounds.
messages.cancelled: Round stopped. Start a new test when ready.

additionalFaqs.question: What does this memory test measure?
additionalFaqs.answer: It is a casual sequence-recall practice game. It is not standardized and cannot diagnose a condition or measure IQ.

additionalFaqs.question: How do digit span and pattern mode differ?
additionalFaqs.answer: Digit span shows digits one at a time and announces them for screen-reader access. Pattern mode flashes positions on a 3×3 grid and requires sight.

additionalFaqs.question: Are scores saved or compared with other people?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Scores exist only while this page remains open. There is no leaderboard, account or server upload.
